'''Ereesus''' was a planet in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and the homeworld of the [[Ereesi/Legends|Ereesi]] species.

==History==
The Ereesi were heavily involved in slave trading and Ereesus was where [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] markets thrived. In [[4200 BBY]], the Ereesi species engaged in slave raids throughout the sector. Their harassment of the [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdans]] prompted the latter to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[4200 BBY]].

Prior to becoming a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Tott Doneeta]] and his family were to be sold in Ereesus' slave markets. Their captor's [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was intercepted, however, by a team of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] led by [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Arca Jeth]] before it reached the city. Doneeta subsequently joined the Jedi Order out of gratitude for his rescuers and served throughout the duration of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

In [[3970 BBY]], [[Argazdan Redoubt]] forces [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|devastated]] the planet Ereesus; exterminating all life including the Ereesi slavers in retaliation for the latter's depredations.

In the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Battle of Ereesus|battle]] took place on Ereesus, with the [[Ereesus Planetary Security Forces]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] fighting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].<ref name="Speaking Silently" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ereesus was mentioned first in the ''[[West End Games]]'' ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''. It later appeared in the short story ''[[Speaking Silently]]''.
